# Mytheon Technologies

> Mytheon Technologies is an AI-first SaaS company based in Almaty, Kazakhstan. We design and launch intelligent, AI-powered products that transform lives and industries.

## About

Mytheon Technologies specialises in developing and launching AI-powered SaaS products for global markets. The company operates on four core principles: AI-Powered (building the next version of the conversational web), Human-Oriented (solving real-world problems one product at a time), Built to Scale (made in Kazakhstan, built for the world), and Moving Fast (from concept to live product in weeks).

- **Website**: https://www.mytheon.co
- **Location**: 133/1 Gagarin Avenue, Almaty, Kazakhstan
- **Contact**: +7 775 422 7619 (WhatsApp)
- **Languages**: English, Russian

## Products

### OpenEMDR.ai
An AI-powered platform making EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) therapy more accessible to therapists and patients worldwide.

- **Category**: Mental Health AI / Healthcare SaaS
- **Target users**: Therapists, mental health professionals, patients
- **Value proposition**: Evidence-based trauma treatment at scale

### AdsCopilot.ai
A smart AI Copilot built for Performance Marketing professionals. Enables marketers to write high-converting ad copy across Google, Meta, TikTok and other platforms in seconds.

- **Category**: AdTech AI / Marketing SaaS
- **Target users**: Performance marketers, digital advertising professionals, agencies
- **Value proposition**: High-converting ad copy across all major platforms, generated in seconds

## Mission

We exist to make AI work for people who actually need it. We build tools that make a real difference — one use case at a time.
